how_to_apply: Apply online through the University website www.rlbcau.ac.in between 18 November 2026 (10:00 AM) and 24 December 2026 (till 05.00 PM), filling in a correct telephone/mobile number and e-mail address.
Fill your Name, Father's name, Mother's name, Date of Birth and Matriculation details exactly as in the 10th class certificate.
Fill in the score card parameters of the form with relevant proof, and upload the certificates and the NOC, if in service.
Pay the fee online (not applicable to Comptroller applicants and women candidates).
Print the online form and sign every page and every enclosure already uploaded.
Send the hard copy through Indian postal service to: Registrar, Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University, Gwalior Road, Jhansi-284003.
Write on the envelope "Application for the post ……" and "Post Code ……"; without this, the application will be rejected.
Make sure the hard copy reaches the University by 31 December 2026; applications received in any other manner are rejected, and the University is not responsible for postal delay or loss.

In-service candidates must send their application through proper channel. The NOC/forwarding must be uploaded online and the original sent with the hard copy; an NOC or forwarded application submitted after the last date of online submission will not be considered. The notice includes the format "Endorsement by the EMPLOYER / NOC" for this purpose. Applicants from abroad may indicate their approximate date of return to India.
important_instructions: Only citizens of India may apply. Not eligible: persons convicted by any Court of Law or facing pending criminal proceedings; persons who married someone with a living spouse, or married while having a living spouse (the Competent Authority may exempt where personal law permits); persons disqualified by the Government of India/UGC. A reserved category candidate who also wants to be considered for an unreserved post must submit separate forms for unreserved and reserved posts. Outstation SC/ST/PwBD candidates are reimbursed to-and-from sleeper class rail fare (or ordinary bus fare by the shortest route) for the interview, except the first 30 KM; this does not apply to those already in Central/State Government service or other employment. Others attend at their own expense. The University may withdraw any post, draw reserve panels for future vacancies, and fill or not fill a post. Interim enquiries are not entertained, and canvassing in any manner leads to disqualification. Any addendum, corrigendum or update is posted only on www.rlbcau.ac.in; no information or call letters are sent by post. False information or documents can lead to rejection or termination at any stage, with action under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Legal disputes fall under the District Court at Jhansi and the Allahabad High Court at Prayagraj.

content_sections.heading: About RLBCAU
content_sections.text: Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University is a central agricultural university at Jhansi-Gwalior Road, Jhansi-284003, Uttar Pradesh, established under the Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University Act, 2014. As per its rules, the Board of Management of the University is the appointing authority for all regular teaching, statutory and non-teaching posts at pay level 10 or above.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The RLBCAU Recruitment 2026 notice has 82 posts: 1 Comptroller, 33 Professor, 27 Associate Professor and 21 Assistant Professor. Every teaching post is filled by Direct recruitment (no mode is printed against post AP-12). In the tables, * marks backlog vacancies and # marks re-advertised posts, as in the notice. The University may increase or decrease the number of advertised posts at any stage without prior notice. Professor total: UR 14, OBC 9, SC 5, ST 2, EWS 3 (33 posts). Associate Professor total: UR 10, OBC 06, SC 05, ST 02, EWS 04 (27 posts). Assistant Professor total: UR 06, OBC 05, SC 04, ST 03, EWS 03 (21 posts). Six posts are marked PwBD in total: P-22, ASP-4, ASP-9, AP-10, AP-15 and AP-21. Each department or discipline may require a particular specialization, and the University reserves the right to shortlist or select candidates as per the requirement of specialization or research area.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: "A" denotes Academic Pay level. The notice does not print the pay amounts in rupees. Higher initial pay may be considered for exceptionally qualified and deserving candidates if recommended by the selection committee. The salary of retired/superannuated persons, if selected, will be fixed after deducting pension from the last pay drawn. The posts are regular posts; service conditions are governed by the Statutes and Rules of the University. Comptroller: as per section 43 (b) of the Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University Act, 2014, the first Comptroller shall be appointed by the Visitor for a term of 3 years, subject to the date of superannuation being 62 years. Age of superannuation for all posts is as per UGC/RLBCAU norms. University employees are covered under the National Pension System; for those appointed on deputation, leave salary and pension contribution are as per rules, and employees covered under the old pension scheme are not entitled to the NPS employer share. Persons employed may be posted/transferred to any Institution within the jurisdiction of the RLB Central Agricultural University, Jhansi. Services of selected in-service candidates are regulated by the statutory provisions of the University. All appointments are provisional, subject to verification of certificates and of the community certificate; the appointment of a fresh candidate is subject to police verification.

faq.question: What is the qualification for RLBCAU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in the relevant discipline with at least 60% marks and NET conducted by ICAR-ASRB, UGC-CSIR, OR a Doctorate with 2 published research papers with NAAS rating of more than 4.0. Veterinary disciplines also need B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks and council registration.

faq.question: What is the age limit for RLBCAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Preferably below 57 years for Comptroller and Professor, below 47 years for Associate Professor and below 40 years for Assistant Professor, as on the last date of advertisement.

faq.question: What is the pay level for RLBCAU Professor and Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Comptroller and Professor are at Level 14, Associate Professor at Level 13 A and Assistant Professor at Level 10 A of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix.

faq.question: What is the application fee for RLBCAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 1000/-, and Rs. 500/- for ST/SC/PwBD, paid online only. Women candidates are exempted, and Comptroller applicants pay no fee.

faq.question: How do I apply for RLBCAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at www.rlbcau.ac.in, then send the signed printout with enclosures by Indian postal service to the Registrar, Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University, Gwalior Road, Jhansi-284003, with the post name and Post Code written on the envelope.

faq.question: What is the selection process for RLBCAU faculty posts?
faq.answer: Score card screening (minimum 60% for an interview call, except Comptroller) followed by an interview, weighted 70:30 for Professor and Associate Professor and 80:20 for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Is the RLBCAU Comptroller post permanent?
faq.answer: The first Comptroller is appointed by the Visitor for a term of 3 years, subject to superannuation at 62 years, and the mode is Direct/ Deputation/ Contract.

faq.question: Can I apply for more than one post in RLBCAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application form with the applicable fee must be submitted for each Position/Post.
